description: ParcelPal 1.2.3 remote-update edition, based on the 1.2.2 diagnostic fix. Adds Scripting remoteResource; auth and keys unchanged.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.3 远程更新版：在 1.2.2 诊断修复（脱敏错误可见、手动同步菜鸟先行、无新增硬超时计时器）基础上，加入 Scripting 远程来源，便于之后从 GitHub 更新。登录与密钥逻辑未改。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.3 remote-update edition of the 1.2.2 diagnostic build. Adds a Scripting remote source. Auth and keys unchanged.
